seo.title: Old House Reconstruction in Georgia | Atelier Sweet Home
seo.description: Reconstruction and practical restoration of old private homes in Georgia: structures, roof, utilities, warmth, water and comfortable living.
seo.ogTitle: Old House Reconstruction | Atelier Sweet Home
seo.ogDescription: An old house can become warm, bright and comfortable while keeping its character.

hero.title: Old house reconstruction in Georgia
hero.mainPhrase: An old house can become warm, bright and comfortable while keeping its character.
hero.text: We restore and renovate old private houses for modern living: strengthen structures, replace unsafe elements, and install reliable heating, water, electricity and bathrooms. We work with attention to materials, details and the overall character of the house.

inspection.title: First, understand the condition of the house
inspection.text: We assess foundations, walls, roof, floors, timber, moisture and existing utilities. After an inspection, it becomes clear what can be kept, where strengthening is needed and where replacement is the safe choice.
inspection.note: This creates a realistic reconstruction plan and a clear sequence of work.

details.title: Keeping the strong details of an old house
details.text: A house often gets its character from stonework, brickwork, old doors, windows, shutters, timber beams, verandas and room proportions. Where an element can be retained and put back into working condition, we restore it or integrate it carefully into the project.

modernLife.title: Adding modern living
modernLife.text: An old house can have proper heating, water supply, electricity, bathrooms, a kitchen, insulation and a practical layout. The interior can remain calm and traditional or become more contemporary, depending on the owner and the house.

situations.title: When to show us the house
items: You bought a house and do not know where to start.
You are looking at a house before buying it.
The roof, walls, beams or floors raise questions.
The house is beautiful but inconvenient to live in.
You want to keep stone, timber, doors, windows or the original layout.

decisions.title: What to keep, strengthen or replace
items: Keep elements that are valuable, sound and safe to use.
Strengthen and repair elements that can be made reliable again.
Replace elements whose condition no longer supports safety and durability.
decisions.note: The final decision follows an inspection and, when necessary, opening selected areas.

scope.title: What reconstruction can include
scope.text: The scope depends on the house, the owner’s task and the intended result.
items: removal of damaged or unnecessary parts
repair and strengthening of timber structures

case.title: House T: restoration for year-round living
case.text: An old private house was bought in damaged condition and restored for comfortable year-round living. The work included a veranda, heating, water supply, electrical work, two bathrooms and interior finishing. The workshop partner took part in the restoration personally and lives in the house.

workshop.title: A small workshop with one responsible contact
workshop.text: The project is led by a master with joinery, construction and restoration experience. An engineer joins complex structural decisions. Welders, concrete workers and other specialists are brought in for the specific scope.
workshop.extra: The owner has one clear contact while the right team is assembled for the house.

start.title: The first step is to show the house
steps: Send photos and the house location.
Briefly describe what you want to change.
We review the material and ask clarifying questions.
If the task is a fit, we arrange a call or an inspection.

faq.title: Common questions
items: Can the condition be understood from photos alone?
Photos help us understand the task and notice some problems. The exact scope is determined after inspection, and sometimes after opening parts of the structure.
Can old beams, walls and doors be kept?
Yes, when their condition allows safe continued use. Each element is assessed separately.
Can reconstruction be carried out in stages?
Often yes. The sequence must account for the roof, walls, foundation and utilities.
An exact cost cannot be calculated from floor area alone. It depends on structures, demolition, materials, utilities, access and finishes.
Our main areas are Tbilisi and Kakheti. Projects elsewhere in Georgia are possible when the task and scale are a good fit.

form.title: Show us your house
form.text: Send a few photos, the location and a short description of what you want to change. We will review the material and get in touch.
fields: What would you like to do?
